MOTOR_CONTROL_INIT: initialize motor control MA pin %1 MB pin %2
MOTOR_CONTROL_INIT_TOOLTIP: Connect one motor's red wire to MA and black wire to MB. Choose any two different output-capable control pins. PWM pins support speed control; AVR non-PWM pins support full speed and stop. For L298N, keep the channel enable jumper installed.
MOTOR_CONTROL_RUN_TOOLTIP: Forward drives MA and holds MB LOW; backward swaps the outputs. PWM pins support speed control. AVR non-PWM pins output full speed for any positive speed, or stop at zero.
L298N_INIT: init channel %1 pin IN1 %2 IN2 %3 EN %4
